items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1961-02-24
items.q: Well, we played Artie Mellenburg, for Alec Baradot.

ctx.x: Well, we played Artie Mellenburg, for Alec Baradot. I can't recall the name of the place. Was that Mellenburg? Alec Baradot.
And that's after World War II? Oh yeah. What about before that, say, around the time of the war?
